newsitem.title: USA: US court freezes assets of Calif commodity trader.
newsitem.headline: US court freezes assets of Calif commodity trader.

text.p: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission said Wednesday it won a federal court order freezing the assets of Carl Hermans of North Hollywood, California, doing business as California Traders Group.
Hermans "aided and abetted the fraud and registration violations" of Edward Schroeder, the commission said.

Last July, the commission charged Schroeder with defrauding more than 40 commodity pool investors of over $3 million. That action is currently in litigation in federal court in California, the commission said.

Judge Henry Hupp of the U.S. District Court for the Central District of California issued an "ex parte freeze order" against Hermans stemming from a five-count civil complaint filed by the CFTC on Feb. 5, the commission said.
Judge Hupp will hold a hearing Feb. 14 on the CFTC's request for a preliminary injunction, the commission said.
